meta.name: dex
meta.description: Task tracking for async/multi-step work. Use dex to create, track, and complete tasks that span multiple sessions or require coordination (e.g., coding agent dispatches, PR reviews, background jobs). Tasks stored as JSON files in .dex/tasks/.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪异步多步骤任务的进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个会话中跟踪和管理复杂任务
copy.tagline_en: Track progress of async multi-step tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track and manage complex tasks across multiple sessions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、跟踪和完成跨多个会话或需要协调的任务（如代码审查、后台作业）。任务以 JSON 文件存储在 .dex/tasks/ 中。
howto.when: 当需要跟踪异步或多步骤工作时触发，例如在开始一个需要后续跟进的任务时，或要求查看当前待办任务时。

say.text: 创建一个任务：添加缓存到 API
say.note: Claude 会创建任务并返回 ID。
Claude 会显示当前未完成的任务列表。

say.text: 完成任务 abc123，结果：PR #50 已合并

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, track, and complete tasks that span multiple sessions or require coordination (e.g., code reviews, background jobs). Tasks are stored as JSON files in .dex/tasks/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when tracking async or multi-step work is needed, e.g., when starting a task that requires follow-up, or when asked to list pending tasks.

say_en.text: Create a task: Add caching to API
say_en.note: Claude creates the task and returns an ID.

say_en.text: Complete task abc123, result: PR #50 merged
